description: Look up 1-10 identifiers (any mix of oclc/isbn/issn/lccn/htid/recordnumber) against the HathiTrust catalog in a single call. Returns the same per-identifier record + item availability data as lookup_by_id, one result per queried identifier — use this instead of repeated lookup_by_id calls when checking availability for a reading list or citation set. Data: HathiTrust Bibliographic API, no auth required.

ids.description: 1-10 identifiers to look up in a single call, each with its own id_type

id_type.description: Identifier type: "oclc" (WorldCat number), "isbn", "issn", "lccn" (Library of Congress Control Number), "htid" (HathiTrust volume ID, e.g. "pur1.32754075735872"), or "recordnumber" (HathiTrust catalog record number)

id_value.description: The identifier value to look up

name: hathitrust-digital.catalog.batch_lookup

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: HathiTrust Batch Catalog Lookup
